μSunfish is a MicroPython derivative of the Sunfish chess engine for microcontrollers like the ESP32. It has a 990-move opening book and the l0 plays on a very easy setting. With a Lichess rating of around 1100 in rapid, is suited for early beginners. Try usunfish-l1 and usunfish-l7 if too easy. Currently running on an Oracle VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro

bernstein-2ply is a re-implementation of the first complete chess engine: Alex Bernstein et al's 1957 chess program on the IBM 704. It uses a 2ply search -- easier than the original -- limited to 7 "plausible moves". Try also @bernstein-4ply, @sargon-1ply or @turochamp-2ply. Author: @herohde.
